perky.binding.perky.flammable.desc: Increase time set on fire by 100%
perky.binding.perky.singlehanded.desc: Removes your off-hand, rendering it unusable.
perky.binding.perky.stackless.desc: Non-block items can only stack up to half of their usual stack size.
perky.binding.perky.witchs_curse.desc: Potions last a shorter amount of time.
perky.perk.perky.builders_pockets.desc: Blocks can now stack up to 99.
perky.perk.perky.cure.desc: Vanilla Debuff effects are significantly shortened.
perky.perk.perky.dexterity.desc: You can reach blocks from further.
perky.perk.perky.grime_filled.desc: Mobs and Loot Chests have more loot.
perky.perk.perky.lighter.desc: Makes fire deal no damage and allows the use of Riptide tridents on fire.
perky.perk.perky.midas_touch.desc: Apples and Carrots act like their Golden counterpart.
perky.perk.perky.mob_boss.desc: Hostile mobs no longer target you when unprovoked.
perky.perk.perky.passive_absorption.desc:
When out of combat for 30+ seconds,
gain 4 hearts of Absorption
perky.perk.perky.slimey.desc: Become smaller and faster when less items are in your inventory.
perky.perk.perky.smooth_landing.desc: Increase safe fall distance by 5 blocks
perky.perk.perky.sponge.desc: Hunger and Saturation are refilled when in water; but size increases.
